The '''Elathan''' were a group<ref name="Power of the Jedi">''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]''</ref> that originated in<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Elatha system/Legends|Elatha system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Stensen sector/Legends|Stensen sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The ''[[Chu'unthor]]'', a [[Jedi academy]] and [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] operated by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], made first contact with the Elathan<ref name="Power of the Jedi" /> between [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]] and [[300 BBY/Legends|300 BBY]],<ref name="Contact Date">''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]'' establishes that the ''[[Chu'unthor]]''{{'s}} first contact with the Elathan occurred during the [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] first [[Standard century/Legends|century]] of service. {{FactFile|95|CHU 1-2|''Chu'unthor''}} states that the ''Chu'unthor'' entered service to [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]], thus first contact must have been made between then and [[300 BBY/Legends|300 BBY]].</ref> which drew the attention of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Media/Legends|media]].<ref name="Power of the Jedi" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Elathan were mentioned in the ''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]'', a sourcebook for ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] in [[2002]].<ref name="Power of the Jedi />
